scope: Temporary synthetic loopback architecture experiments; no application scaffold, UI, real authentication, database or deployment.

checks: Typed client -> real HTTP -> independent backend operation -> typed response
Runtime output schema excludes an internal field
Synthetic replay uses one stored result; this is not production concurrency proof
Malformed input rejected before the application operation
Unexpected authority field rejected at input boundary
Application policy exercised independently of client presentation
Invalid backend output rejected at runtime
TanStack query options preserve inferred response types over HTTP
OpenAPI request and response document generated from the same contract

compatibilityAdjustments: Strict peer resolution rejected TypeScript 7.0.2 because openapi-typescript 7.13.0 declares TypeScript ^5.x
Used stable TypeScript 5.9.3 for the experiment
Added json-schema-to-ts 3.1.1 and @types/js-yaml 4.0.9 for generator dependency declarations

checks: Generated request and response types consumed over real HTTP
Internal field excluded from the runtime response
Two independent client instances share the same synthetic backend operation
Malformed requests rejected before application execution
Injected authority field rejected at input boundary
Declared error status and shape reach the client with inferred types
Explicit backend response validation rejects invalid domain output
Client response validation rejects a malformed successful wire response
Inferred response properties flow into typed presentation code
OpenAPI 3.1 and TypeScript declarations generated from one route contract

limitations: In-memory deduplication does not prove concurrent transaction correctness
Synthetic request headers are test principals, not an authentication mechanism
Typed presentation was not a rendered UI
No real phones, browser bundles, production compatibility, throughput or latency tests
Temporary source directories are local experiment artifacts and may not persist; the result record is retained here
